body.en: It is on the critical path.

title.en: PROJ-124: retry also covers a timed-out payment, not only a declined one
title.zh: PROJ-124：重试也覆盖超时的支付，不只是被拒的支付

body.en: The ticket says "retry a failed payment". A timeout is a failure too, so the worker retries it once. That widens the scope: a timed-out charge may have gone through. Undo: the next pass limits the retry to declines and pushes the fix to PR 4512.
body.zh: Ticket 写的是“支付失败时重试”。超时也算失败，所以 worker 对超时也重试一次。这扩大了范围：超时的扣款可能其实已经成功。撤销：下一次调度把重试限制在“被拒”这一种，并把修改推到 PR 4512。

body.zh: 原因：改动更小。撤销：下一次调度会还原。
